watch.name: Positive Mental Attitude
watch.window: Chapter 1, the balcony after Down to Earth
watch.why: The morning meditation with Lucia is offered once and is gone when the chapter ends. The spot may not be needed for the trophy, but nobody has ruled it out.
watch.action: Follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept the meditation before you start Chapter 2.

watch.name: Supply & Demand
watch.window: After Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3
watch.why: Randy's list is a long delivery run over 16 cars, and the rarer models are easy to pass by while the story pulls you on.
watch.action: Scan cars with WAiNK, shop the hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and finish the list before the endgame.

watch.name: Spin On This!
watch.why: The strand belongs to Jason alone, and the labs are scattered across Vice City rather than gathered in one place.
watch.action: Take Tyrone's calls as Jason and destroy the purple synthetic labs before the story closes.

watch.name: Road to Rehabilitation
watch.why: Andy texts Lucia an address and the five jobs run in a fixed order, so a chapter turn can leave the line half done.
watch.action: Play all five jobs in order, ending on Puff Puff Pass, or come back for them after the credits.

watch.name: This Was No Boat Accident
watch.why: Kenton stops calling after Chapter 1 and only gets back in touch much later, so the seven wrecks sit unfinished for hours.
watch.action: Track the wrecks under Kenton's Treasures and finish the set when he texts Jason again.

watch.name: The Lone Rider
watch.why: Billy's jobs sit at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, well off the story route, and the fifth is easy to leave for later.
watch.action: Finish Coffee Break, then run all five jobs at the mudclub through Hometown Heroes.

watch.name: Fair Game
watch.why: Bret's hunting line opens with a text and a mission in Lummox County, far from where the chapter sends you.
watch.action: Answer Bret as Jason and work the purple Target Decks, which 100 percent needs anyway.

watch.name: Strangers & Freaks
watch.window: Any time, best after the story
watch.why: Only some strands qualify, and the confirmed ones are four, so the counter can sit still while you finish lines that do not count.
watch.action: Finish Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete first, then watch the trophy counter as you add four more qualifying strands.

watch.name: Hot Together
watch.window: After Coffee Break, both characters together
watch.why: It needs a partner call plus a four star chase, which is not something the story hands you after the credits.
watch.action: Call your partner, raise four stars, and break the chase in the tunnel north of Ambrosia.

watch.name: Retail Therapy
watch.why: The wanted level has to survive all three robberies, and the trophy can lag by half a minute after the third.
watch.action: Use the three jewelry stores in north Vice City with armour and healing, and rob a fourth if the bronze is late.
